Municipality Agent Demo Kit

City of San Diego resident assistant · live on Amazon Bedrock · updated 2026-09-15
5containers, one compose file
5model tiers, one env file to swap
16tools, 4 application types
133knowledge base chunks, 9 topics
574unit tests, 21 browser tests, 13 smoke steps
132golden questions in 6 categories

A chat turn is classified by a small model, routed to a tier, answered from City records by tool calls and from policy text by retrieval, then written to a trace. A form or document in the chat starts a back-office workflow that staff advance to an issued certificate.

Front end

  • Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind 4, port 3001
  • Chat streams tokens over server-sent events
  • Resident app at /; staff console at /staff with queue, dashboard, traces

API

  • FastAPI, Python 3.12, SQLAlchemy async, port 8080
  • Classify, route, retrieve, tool loop, cite, trace
  • Cookie-bound sessions, per-IP rate limits, idempotency keys, row-locked workflow engine

Model layer

  • One client module, OpenAI protocol, LiteLLM gateway to Bedrock
  • Haiku classify, Sonnet answer, Opus escalate, Nova Lite extract, Titan embed
  • Ollama and OpenAI profiles are the same code

Data layer

  • Postgres 16 with pgvector: records, vectors, full text
  • SeaweedFS over the S3 API for uploads and certificates
  • Hybrid retrieval, reciprocal rank fusion, top 5 cited

Live City data

  • City geocoder, ArcGIS layers: districts, sweeping, zoning, permits
  • 4 s timeout, 10 min cache, seed fallback, never a 500
  • Every result labelled live or seed on the trace

Other documents

  • Walkthrough with screenshots of every page
  • DEMO_SCRIPT.md, PRODUCTION_PLAN.md, README.md in this folder
  • Repo docs: ARCHITECTURE, DESIGN, EXPLAINER, HARDENING_AUDIT (three reviews verbatim)

#AskExpect (verified 2026-09-14)Point at
1What day is my trash picked up at 4521 Adams Ave?What day is trash picked up at 10615 Calle Mar de Mariposa?Zone Z06, Wednesday, next recycling Wed Sep 16, citations. Second address is not seeded: Tuesday, ZIP-level answer, link to the City's collection map.Trace drawer: one small-tier classify, one tool call, one smart-tier answer. Second trace: match: geocoded.
2Is trash pickup delayed for Thanksgiving?Thursday Nov 26. Thursday and Friday routes move one day later. No address needed.get_holiday_schedule answers first, then offers to narrow by address.
3How much is a business tax certificate for 3 employees?Base fee, SB-1186 fee, minimum wage enforcement fee, about $43.88, labelled an estimate.Same pure function in tools/fees.py feeds the validator, so the quote is the filing.
4What's happening this weekend?Sat Sep 19 Pride parade, Sun Sep 20 coding workshop. Seeded rows.Every prompt ends with today's date. Do not promise live council agendas; the RSS merge returned none today.
5Who is my council member if I live at 202 C St?District 3, Stephen Whitburn, (619) 236-6633, "according to the City's live map data".Trace: source: live, match: geocoded. Nav badge: fictional applications, live City map data.
6Can I park my RV on the street overnight in Pacific Beach?Not by default: 27 ft rule, 2 to 6 a.m., TORVP permit, cited from parking.md.This question produced an invented fee before the parking KB existed. Strict-sources rule.
7What's the status of tracking number SR-2026-999888?Clean miss, the general line 619-236-5555, no invented status.The model may not state a number no tool returned.
8Attach sample_permit_application.pdf, send Here is my permit application.Extracted fields, a PRM tracking number, department, estimated fee, green tracking card.SeaweedFS, pypdf, extract tier into the same pydantic model as the form. Reply is templated, not generated.
9Switch to /staffThe new row is already in_review. Advance to approved, then issued, download the certificate.Worker polls every 3 s. The engine is the only writer of status, so the timeline cannot be skipped.
9bAttach sample_permit_incomplete.pdf, then reply The permit type is Building Permit with Plans and the valuation is $80,000"I still need: permit type, valuation". Queue shows needs_info, then in_review with a fee.Follow-up extracted against only the missing fields. The state machine re-validates, not the model.
9cOptional: quick action "Apply for a short-term rental license", or attach sample_stro_application.pdfFourteen fields extracted, a Tier from the ordinance, an STR- number, Treasurer, flat fee per tier. Staff issue a licence PDF that names the tier.The fourth type took the same schema, form, extraction and state machine. Nothing bespoke.
10Switch to /staff/dashboard, then /staff/traces, expand one rowDashboard: turns, cost, p50 and p95, intents, tiers, tool error rate, live share, applications by status, and the unanswered list. Traces: every turn with tool JSON, source and match.The unanswered panel is how a city finds its next KB gap. Eval numbers in the table below.
11Show .env.ollama beside .env.bedrockSame code, tier aliases, one compose profile starts LiteLLM.Phase 2 real spend: about $9.74 of a $10 budget for this project's models. Do not say "about $5".

If something breaks

SymptomCauseOn the spot
First answer takes 10 to 30 sGateway or knowledge base just startedSay so. The warm-up turn in the checklist prevents it.
Nav pill is reddb, s3, llm or embed is downHover it, it names the component. docker compose logs api --tail 30.
"Based on demo data" where you expected liveSeed match, or ArcGIS timed out at 4 sThe fallback working as designed. Point at source on the trace.
Model answers without calling the toolDropped tool call on a long turnOpen the trace, show it, re-ask directly: "look up 4521 Adams Ave".
Upload says no text foundThe PDF is a scan, no OCRIntended. Offer to type the details. The sample PDFs are text-based.
Application sits in submittedWorker off, or the 5 s pollCheck WORKER_ENABLED, click a filter to refetch.
Library-card question gets "not configured"SEARCH_PROVIDER=noneSay so. The tool reports itself off instead of guessing.
Everything is wrongStale database statebash scripts/reset_demo.sh, about a minute.

What is real and what is a fixture

Real today

City geocoderCouncil districtsStreet sweepingZoningPermits on fileCouncil agenda RSS Router and tiersTool registryHybrid retrievalWorkflow engineTraces and costEvalsStaff authProvider swap

Fixture today

40 addresses12 collection zones25 eventsPermit types and fee rates311 categoriesReferralsApplications and tracking numbers9 KB files curated from City pages

Nothing the model says comes from the fixture directly. Every fact arrives through a typed tool result or a cited chunk, labelled live or seed on the trace.

The seam: the tool contract is the semantic layer

Production adds three fields to every result: owner (the system that answered), as_of (when it last updated the record), scope (public, resident-own, staff). Aggregate questions become one tool each over a metrics layer. The model never writes SQL.

When the data is not clean

ProblemHandled whereWhat the resident sees
Address does not matchResolver: seed, City geocoder at score 80 or better, then ZIP. Production adds a confirm step below threshold."Is this the address you mean?" or a ZIP-level answer labelled as such
Inconsistent codes, duplicatesAdapter canonicalizes, keeps raw and normalized valuesThe summary states which value was used
Stale or conflicting recordsas_of on every result, one precedence rule per conceptThe answer states the source and its date
Missing fields on an applicationValidator and the needs_info state, builtAsked for the missing fields in chat
Schema drift upstreamPydantic fails loudly, dispatch() turns it into an error the model reads, golden set catches the regression"Could not retrieve" plus a phone number, never a wrong answer
Scanned documentspypdf today. Add OCR with a confidence score; low confidence routes to in_reviewA person checks it
PIIStatus tools strip applicant details, built. Production scopes rows by signed-in userOnly their own records
A City service is down4 s timeout, 10 min cache, seed fallbackAn answer labelled "based on demo data", or a referral

Two production shapes

A. One VM, compose, TLS, backups recommended for a pilot

PieceDoes for this appMonth
EC2 m6i.large, 100 GBRuns the five compose services as today, memory limits already set$80
Caddy containerTLS, proxies / and /api, idle timeout above the 45 s model timeout, HSTS$0
S3 bucket, versionedNightly backup.sh off the host; restore.sh is the monthly drill$2
Instance role, SSM parametersNo keys on disk; secrets rendered into .env at boot$0
CloudWatch agentContainer logs with request ids, two alarms: health non-200, disk over 80%$5

About $90 a month plus model usage. Removes: plaintext staff cookie, secrets in user-data, backups on the same disk, a full disk, an unnoticed outage. Keeps: one host, one API process.

B. Managed containers, RDS, S3

PieceDoes for this appMonth
ECS Fargate: api x2, web x2, worker x1, litellm x1Same images. Rate limits and worker claims are Postgres-backed, so two api tasks are safe$115
ALB, ACM certificate, WAFTLS, path routing, 120 s idle timeout for streams, health check pulls a degraded task$35
RDS PostgreSQL 16 Multi-AZ, pgvectorReplaces the Postgres container. DATABASE_URL changes, nothing else$110
S3Replaces SeaweedFS. Real signatures, bucket policy, versioning$2
Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, NATSecrets as task env with rotation; logs, alarms on 5xx and p95; outbound to Bedrock and sandiego.gov$52

About $310 a month plus model usage. Removes on top of A: the single host, the single process, the unauthenticated object store, hand-run backups. Adds: a platform to operate.

Same in both: the image, the migrations, the tool contracts, the evals, the dashboard. ENVIRONMENT=prod refuses placeholder secrets and a non-TLS origin in both. Prices are approximate us-west-2 list prices at about 1,000 turns a day; model usage is about $0.03 a turn.

Hostile review and load test, and what happened to each finding

FindingMeasuredStatus
Stream route held a pool connection for the life of the stream20 concurrent streams: every one 60 s then an apology; 50: 30 HTTP 500sfixed 50 concurrent: p95 0.43 s, zero 500s, overflow gets 429
Concurrency cap acquired after headers were sentRaising it changed nothingfixed 429 with Retry-After before the body
Nothing survives a second replicaWorker, ingest, throttle, semaphore all in-processmostly worker SKIP LOCKED, ingest advisory lock, per-IP limits in Postgres; login throttle still per process
Certificate render and boto3 on the event loop under a row lockSlow object store stalls every streamfixed threads, 3 s connect, 10 s read, 2 attempts
UTC clock in a Pacific cityTrash day wrong after 5 pm PT; 2027 numbers on New Year's Evefixed one clock module, TZ in compose, frozen-clock test
Double submit filed twice; session id client-chosen30 identical posts, 30 applicationsfixed Idempotency-Key, 60 s dedupe, HMAC cookie per session
Daily cost cap read-then-spend, no per-IP limitCap overshoots by the in-flight fleetfixed per-IP token bucket, 80% warning; cap remains a read (documented)
No TLS, secrets on disk, single gatewayDesign, not codedocumented both production shapes above; LiteLLM fallbacks configured
Messages stored forever, readable by any staff accountDesignpartial retention setting with a sweep, default keep for the demo; one staff role
CI never exercised web, the gateway, or concurrencyGreen while brokenfixed full compose stack, stub model that classifies, smoke and a 20-stream probe, Trivy image scans
No down migrations, restore never runDesignfixed down files and a rollback flag; restore drill run against a real backup

Left out by decision

Each of these was considered and skipped. The reason is the point; a reviewer who asks gets the reason, not a shrug.

GapWhy it was left outProduction answer
PaymentsEvery fee is an estimate. Taking money is PCI scope and shows nothing about the agent.Hand off to the City's existing payment portal with the estimate prefilled.
Resident accountsA browser session id ties a conversation together. Auth exists only where documents get issued (staff).SSO with the City's identity provider; row scope by user.
Real write integrationsAccela and Get It Done have no public write API. Filing is simulated and the nav badge says so.Adapters behind the same tool contracts once credentials exist.
OCRText PDFs cover the demo. A scan is stored, flagged, and the assistant says it cannot read it.Textract or similar, confidence-gated into human review.
SpanishOne probe answered correctly, but it could not be scored mechanically, so it is not claimed.Add scored Spanish items to the golden set before claiming it.
Web search offBuilt and tested. Off until a Brave key is decided; the tool reports itself unconfigured rather than guessing.Two env lines and an api restart.
Realistic plan-check fee rateSeed models IB-101 at 4 cents per $1,000 of valuation, so "with plans" fees come out small. It is a seed number, not code.Change per_1000_valuation_cents in permit_types.json.
Sequential tracking numbersPRM-2026-000104 style ids are readable in a demo. They are guessable; status lookups return no applicant PII and conversations are cookie-bound.Opaque ids plus row scope by an authenticated resident.
Lookup by a real City permit numbersearch_city_permits takes an address only. A resident holding a PMT number gets an honest "cannot look that up".One more ArcGIS query keyed by permit number.
Contradictory addresses in one messageResolved silently to the last one. Rare, and the reply shows the address it used.Prompt rule: name every address seen and ask which.
City name with no ZIP"Carmel Valley" without a street or ZIP is asked for an address rather than guessed.Neighborhood to ZIP table in the resolver.
Citation cosmeticsAn out-of-range [3] marker is dropped from the chips but stays in the text; chips render in first-cited order.Renumber markers in citations_for.
Live council agendasThe Granicus RSS merge is wired but returned nothing today. Seeded meetings cover the demo.Legistar API with dates, not RSS.
LLM-as-judge evalsEvery score is mechanical: intent match, tool match, citation present, keyword present, guardrail phrase. No judge model, so no judge bias.Add a judged rubric for answer quality beside the mechanical scores.
AWS deploymentdeploy/aws/up.sh puts the stack on one EC2 instance with a Bedrock instance role. Scripted, never run; the demo runs on a Mac.Run it. ECS or App Runner after that.
Login throttle per processThe staff lockout counter is in memory; every other shared state moved to Postgres in M26.One more Postgres-backed counter.
Faithfulness scoringEvals are mechanical: intent, tool, citation, keywords, guardrail, and no invented numbers. No judge model, so no judge bias.A per-claim faithfulness check beside the mechanical scores.
Language accessEnglish only, by decision. Spanish answered correctly in probes but was never scored.Scored Spanish golden items, a language field on the trace, a UI switch.
Records retention and PRATRACE_RETENTION_DAYS exists and defaults to keep everything; the Public Records Act sets a two-year floor before destruction.A written retention schedule and a redaction procedure.
Multi-tenant, mobile polishOne city, one staff account. Pages pass a 390 px viewport test and no more.Tenant column and a design pass.

Before you start

  1. Health is green at localhost:8080/health, kb_chunks is 133. The stack was reset to seeded state on 2026-09-14.
  2. Tabs: chat /, staff console /staff (queue, dashboard, traces), systems map, walkthrough. Sign in once at /login with staff / staff.
  3. Send hi in the chat and wait for the reply, so the first real answer is warm.
  4. Finder window is on sample documents. Drag from there into the chat composer.
  5. Nav badge reads "demo, fictional applications, live City map data". That sentence is beat 5.
  6. Do not click Brave's "Update" button. It restarts the browser.

Recovery

cd ~/Desktop/Take\ Home\ Project
bash scripts/demo_up.sh        # stack down: starts Docker, containers, warms Bedrock, opens tabs
bash scripts/reset_demo.sh     # stale data: backs up, wipes to seeded state, about a minute
bash scripts/restore.sh        # restore drill of the newest backup into a scratch database
bash scripts/spend.sh          # spend, app estimate and AWS per-model lines

Staff login is staff / staff. Ports: web 3001, api 8080, postgres 5433, S3 8333, LiteLLM 4000.
